name: generic
aspect_notes: Approximate 16:9 search regions, not pixel-exact UI contracts. Native 16:10/ultrawide retains height-relative HUD size with left/right/center anchors; stretched or customized HUDs need calibration. For pillarbox/letterbox footage use pixels(..., letterboxed=True) or crop to the content first. UI scale, patches and spectator overlays can shift regions.
alive_rules: Require a visible player health HUD and direct control appropriate to the game; never require a crosshair in top-down games.
dead_rules: Death overlay, respawn timer, or an explicit personal death banner.
spectating_rules: Spectator label, kill cam, replay, or camera following someone else.
highlights: Confirmed player multikills, objective wins, and low-health outplays.
lowlights: Avoidable deaths or failed abilities with visible consequences.
